ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark grey) and 25% high-intensity (white) pixels localized to lateral zones and tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern across trailing edges; mean amplitude of ~5-10 pixels with high spatial frequency across the entire posterior boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curve with sharp tapering toward the central notch; outer edges exhibit a broad convex sweep.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive rake marks consisting of multiple parallel lines on the right lobe distal region; localized physical edge irregularities at both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique black pigmentation 'hook' or 'whale-tail' shaped feature isolated within the white field of the left lobe.
